name: Samophlange Manual
summary: In Orgrimmar, Rilli Greasygob seeks the scattered pages of the Samophlange Manual. The handbook holds instructions for repairing and operating the Venture Company's samophlange.

sections.title: Secrets of the Contraption
sections.body: Boss Copperplug guarded the Venture Company's knowledge of the samophlange. The ambitious overseer kept the manual's pages from most workers, giving scattered leaves only to his most loyal subordinates. When the device slipped from company hands, no one could repair it without gathering the torn documentation from Copperplug and his crew at the Boulder Lode Mine.

sections.title: A Rival's Ambition
sections.body: Rilli Greasygob left the Venture Company and settled in Orgrimmar to learn how the samophlange was built. Copperplug had never favored him, so Rilli depends on enterprising travelers to retrieve the manual's cover and loose leaves. Reassembled, the handbook gives goblin tinkerers working alongside the Horde a rare look at Venture Company engineering.

faq.answer: The Samophlange Manual explains how to operate and repair the Venture Company's complex, eccentric mechanical device.
Boss Copperplug, a Venture Company overseer at the Boulder Lode Mine in the northeastern Barrens, kept the manual. He guarded its secrets and gave individual pages only to his most trusted workers.

faq.q: Why is the manual torn into pages?
faq.answer: Boss Copperplug separated the manual to keep rivals and untrusted subordinates from understanding the whole device. He kept the cover and distributed five specific pages among his miners and operators.

faq.q: Who wants to read the completed manual?
faq.answer: Rilli Greasygob, an engineer in Orgrimmar, wants the reassembled manual to understand and repair the broken samophlange recovered from the Barrens.

faq.q: What is a samophlange used for?
faq.answer: No one outside the Venture Company seems to know what a samophlange is used for. The company experimented with one at a small research site southwest of the Sludge Fen in the Barrens, but even the engineers who studied it could make little sense of it.

angles.text: The manual reveals proprietary Venture Company technology and shows how goblin tinkerers guard trade secrets and working schematics from their peers.
The manual lets Horde-aligned goblins in Orgrimmar study and repurpose corporate drilling machinery under the Venture Company's nose.
